verdict.rationale: Render provides ephemeral preview environments for entire application architectures per change (render-docs-8) and explicitly offers a feature to prevent non-production environments from accessing production services (render-docs-18), directly supporting sandbox testing isolated from production data. However, there's no detailed documentation on data seeding/masking for sandboxes, no explicit 'staging vs production' workflow guide, and no independent/hands-on verification of this isolation working in practice. missing for 10: independent verification of production-data isolation in practice, documentation on sandbox data seeding/anonymization, explicit staging-environment workflow guide.
